title: 6DOF Acceleration
text: Implement quaternion representation of six-degrees-of-freedom equations of motion with respect to body axes, 2 inputs, 9 outputs, {Mass type} sets Mass type; {Units} sets the input and output units Metric, {Initial position in inertial axes [Xe,Ye,Ze]} sets the position in inertial axes, {Initial velocity in body axes [U,v,w]} sets the velocity in body axes, {Initial Euler orientation [roll, pitch, yaw]} sets the initial Euler orientation, {Initial body rotation rates [p,q,r]} sets the initial body rotation, {Initial mass}, {Inertia}, {Position: e.g., ’Xe’,’Ye’,’Ze’} sets the position state name, {Velocity: e.g., ’U’,’v’,’w’} sets the velocity state name, {Quaternion: e.g., ’qr’,’qi’,’qj’,’qk’} sets the quaternion vector state name, {Body rotation rates: e.g., ’p’,’q’,’r’} sets the body rotation state names and {Output mass properties for acceleration computation} sets the include mass properties for acceleration. Values come from the instance.
